top_signals.title: Texas Is Tip Of A Melting Muni Iceberg: Winkler
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Matt Winkler joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Borrowing costs for the state of Texas are higher than they are for California. The yield that investors demand on Texas bonds are, on average, point-3 percentage points higher than the Golden State. That adds up to as much as 3 million dollars annually for every 1 billion borrowed in Texas. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
top_signals.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
